description: This PHP class 'Language' represents a Data Transfer Object (DTO) for handling language information related to an employee within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for entity normalization, retrieving language data for an employee, and defining field mappings.

classes.name: Language
classes.description: A DTO class for representing language information linked to an employee, with capabilities for normalization and field mapping.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Language DTO with an employee number.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns an array of language data for the employee, normalized according to the specified fields.

methods.name: getFieldGetterMap
methods.description: Provides a mapping of field names to their respective getter methods within the Employee entity.
